name: Sakurai Koji
source:
Works for a trading company.

Father of Makoto. He is an honest and quiet man who is trusted by everyone around him, including the company.

When he was transferred to a new office of the company, he left his son in the care of his mother.

From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mamatuma.htmll]official site[/url].
